BadField.description: `bad-field`: a field is out of range or of the other connection type; the error names it

BadRequest.description: `bad-request`: the body or a query is not the shape the route takes

Failed.description: `failed`: the service failed; the error is the failure as a sentence

Incomplete.description: `incomplete`: the node lacks a field its connection type needs

NameRule.description: `name-rule`: the name is not lowercase letters, digits and hyphens of at most 32 characters

NameTaken.description: `name-taken`: a node of that name is already listed

NoHub.description: `no-hub`: no hub of that address is listed

NoNode.description: `no-node`: no node of that name is listed; for a machine, no machine of that name

NoRoute.description: `no-route`: no route answers this method and path

NotSsh.description: `not-ssh`: the node is reached through a hub and has no SSH route

Unauthorized.description: `unauthorized`: the token is missing or wrong

BoardView.description: Everything the board reports that belongs to no other piece: its own temperatures and its fans.

CheckNodes.description: Which nodes to check now: the one named, or every node.

ChipView.description: The chip as it physically stands (docs/hardware.md, 「The chip」).

rows.description: The package's rows of dies, top to bottom; a null is a place on the package with no die in it.

usage.description: Share busy across the core's threads, 0 to 1.

CpuLimit.description: A machine's CPU limit as kept.

CpuLimitSet.description: The CPU limit to set; null clears it.

celsius.description:
The package's temperature: the chip's own package sensor, or the hottest of the CPU's sensors; and
the limit that sensor's chip names, none where it names none (「Temperature limits」).

mhz.description: The mean effective clock across the threads that answered one, and the fastest of them.

direction.description: Which way its items stand: `column`, one above the other, or `row`, side by side.

ErrorCode.description: Why a request was not answered with its route's own answer.

limitCelsius.description: The temperature it slows down at, and whether thermal slowdown holds its clocks down now.

HardwareView.description: One machine's reading as a screen draws it: one group per piece of hardware.

Health.description:
Whether the service stands: its process, its version, and whether its store is open and its loops
have started.

HistoryBand.description: One series across a span: each point's lowest, highest and mean, null where nothing was recorded.

HistoryRange.description:
One span of the history: the start of each point's stretch in epoch milliseconds, the width of one,
and each figure's band.

Hub.description: A jake hub: its control address and the file its token is kept in.

HubRemoved.description: A hub removed, and the jake nodes reached through it, removed with it.

Item.description: A group of cores around their shared cache, or a part of a die that is not a core.

JakeTarget.description: A jake node's connection: its agent and the hub it is reached through.

LatestReading.description: A machine's latest reading, or the failure met reading it.

failure.description: What was met where the machine could not be read.

hardware.description: Null where the machine was not read.

readAt.description: When the reading was taken, in epoch milliseconds.

tracking.description: Whether the machine's live tracking is on; a machine not tracked has neither a reading nor a failure.

LiveRange.description:
Live readings as columns: when each was taken, in epoch milliseconds, and each figure's value at each
of those times, null where that reading did not carry it.

Login.description: The arguments that open a batch SSH login to a node, ahead of the command.

LoginShell.description: The language an ssh node's login answers a command in.

MachineKind.description: How a machine is reached: this machine itself, or a node of either connection type.

MachinePressure.description: A pressure on the service's machine, told once (docs/machine.md).

oneOf.description: Memory `full` at or above the alert line, standing for the alert minutes.

fullPct.description: The memory `full` over the last minute, in percent.

oneOf.description: The data root's disk under the launch line.

label.description: The name where none is given.

Node.description: A node as every route answers it. It holds no credential, only where one is kept.

address.description:
Where it is reached: `user@host`, `:port` after it where the port is not 22 and ` (PowerShell)` where
the login answers in PowerShell; `agent @ hub` for a jake node.

agent.description: A jake node's agent, by the name its hub knows it by.

checkedAt.description: When the last check was made, in epoch milliseconds.

connectedAt.description: When the node was last found connected, in epoch milliseconds.

credential.description: Where the credential is kept: an ssh node's key path, or the token file of a jake node's hub.

role.description: The services the node is reserved for, joined by `+`.

takesJobs.description:
An ssh node other than the service's own machine, whose login is not PowerShell's and whose role is
none or names `jobs`.

thisMachine.description: An ssh node whose host names the service's own machine.

up.description: The last check found the node connected and was made within the link window.

NodeChanges.description: A change to a node: only the fields sent change, and null clears `keyPath` and `role`.

NodeKind.description: A node's connection type: logged into over SSH, or a jake agent reached through its hub.

NodeState.description: One state a node's check comes to (docs/nodes.md, 「The states」).

NodesChanged.description: A pass moved a node's state, or the list changed; a consumer showing the nodes reads them again.

Place.description: What one agent place holds of the machine.

full.description: Null for a resource the kernel keeps no `full` line for.

PressureLine.description: The share of a stretch some or all tasks stood stalled, in percent, over 10, 60 and 300 seconds.

Reading.description: The machine as its kernel reads, every reading that cannot be had null rather than a nought.

at.description: When it was read, in epoch milliseconds.

diskFreeGb.description: The free space of the data root's disk, for a writer that is not the root user.

Removed.description: The node a removal took away, by its name.

Room.description: What the machine is short of for another launch, read now; empty where it has room.

Sensor.description: One temperature input of a chip.

device.description: The device the chip belongs to, where the kernel names one.

limitCelsius.description:
The critical temperature the chip names for this input, or the highest where it names no critical
one (docs/hardware.md, 「Temperature limits」).

keyPath.description:
The private key the login offers, as the row holds it; a leading `~/` is the home of the account that
reads it.

options.description:
The OpenSSH options of a batch login, each given after `-o`, the options a key brings among them where
the node names a key; the same for `ssh`, `sftp` and `scp`.

Standing.description: The machine as the minute watch read it.

browsers.description: How many browser main processes run.

held.description: What the machine is short of for another launch, each an English reason with its figure.

places.description: What each agent place holds, largest first.

reading.description: Null where the machine could not be read, which holds nothing.

key.description:
Unique within the machine: the kernel's name, `win<n>` for a Windows disk, `net:<source>` for a
network share.

kind.description: What the device is, as the probe tells it (docs/hardware.md, 「Storage」).

usedKb.description: Across its volumes; none where none of it is mounted.

Target.description: The one form a node is reached by, whatever reaches it.

Tone.description: How a state reads at a glance: reached, not reached, or not yet asked.

Tracking.description: A machine's tracking switch as kept.

Watts.description: Package power over the sample in watts, or `denied` where the account may not read the counter.

WireError.description: The body of every answer that is not the route's own: its code and an English sentence.

bearer.description: The service's token, from the caller's own configuration.

info.description: The node service: the machines reachable from here and what is known of them. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys, and times are integers of epoch milliseconds; a duration is named by its unit. Every route needs the service's bearer token. Every failure and refusal is a non-2xx status with a body of `code` and `error`, so a 2xx answer is always the route's own. A list takes one cursor, `after`, and `limit`. Any other method and path is answered 404 `no-route`.
